OG retains twenty-three singles, shared A and two balconies. EG follows the general sketch with twenty-three singles, inserted B, shifted shared A, Sports room in the former F/west gap, and Laundry beside N0. Folded exterior evidence remains unchanged.

level.label: EG · module layout
level.source: Resident House 51 / EG general sketch, 15 November 2026: retain the middle-floor single-room splits and N0; insert B before shared A and shift A right; combine former F and the west gap into Sports room; extend the east gap beside N0 as Laundry.
level.notes: Resident general sketch fitted to the accepted middle-floor modules: twenty-three singles and one shared A envelope. H/G, N4/N3 and W2/W1 stay split, and N0 remains beside N1. The A-bank F single becomes part of Sports room; B is inserted before shared A, which moves right by one 3.10 m pitch. Sports is the 9.30 x 7.40 m west enclosure; Laundry is the 6.20 x 7.40 m east enclosure beside N0. Each common room has one hallway entrance. Singles keep 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors, two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m pitch. Halls stay 1.40 m; shared A keeps its 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelope. Common dimensions are inferred from module alignment. Clear lime door ends are followed for Sports and A-wing E/D/C; other existing apartments retain the middle-floor pattern. B uses a schematic bottom-right entrance and Laundry inherits the stair-side balcony doorway. Openings are schematic 0.90 m widths; hinges, swings and exact jambs are unresolved. The independent outline has no residual gaps. Stair and rigid coordinate frame align exactly with both unchanged upper floors. The former F window belongs to Sports, B receives one schematic window, and A retains two shifted openings. Source facade geometry and window evidence are unchanged.
